name: wireshark-mcp
description: анализ пакетов через tshark: .pcap, статистика, HTTP/DNS, расшифровка TLS, YARA
argv: test -x "$HOME/.venvs/wireshark-mcp/bin/wireshark-mcp" || { printf 'wireshark-mcp не собран: запусти mcp-station/bin/debug-setup.sh\n' >&2; exit 1; }; command -v tshark >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'нет tshark: sudo dnf install wireshark-cli\n' >&2; exit 1; }; export WIRESHARK_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS="${WIRESHARK_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS:-$HOME}"; exec "$HOME/.venvs/wireshark-mcp/bin/wireshark-mcp" serve
